description: Unit tests for the HeaderValidator component in the HTTP/2 adapter, validating header syntax, pseudo-headers, and protocol-specific rules.

classes.name: HeaderValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating HTTP/2 headers according to protocol rules.

methods.name: ValidateSingleHeader
methods.description: Validates a single header field and value.

methods.name: SetMaxFieldSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed size for header fields.

methods.name: StartHeaderBlock
methods.description: Begins validation for a new header block.

methods.name: FinishHeaderBlock
methods.description: Completes validation for a header block, checking protocol-specific rules.

methods.name: content_length
methods.description: Returns the parsed Content-Length value if available.

methods.name: status_header
methods.description: Returns the value of the :status pseudo-header.

methods.name: SetAllowExtendedConnect
methods.description: Enables validation rules for extended CONNECT method headers.

methods.name: IsValidHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks if a header value is valid according to header value rules.

methods.name: IsValidAuthority
methods.description: Validates authority header values, including IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
